subject: Bridging timezones: stakeholder sync for demo & procurement checklist
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@zenithcorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Monroe <amonroe@zenithcorp.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (Zenith)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the initial convo yesterday. We're excited to see Redwood in action. Our team (SE + procurement + security) needs a demo that covers: runbook for private deployment, data isolation controls, and a short Q&A with Security.

High-level availability from our side this week: Tue-Fri mornings CET (09:00-11:00) and Tue/Thu afternoons SGT (14:00-17:00). Procurement would prefer a slot that lands late-morning CET so Alex can join.

Can Camila or someone in your pre-sales team cover the technical runbook and quantization/throughput questions? Also, can you share any short prep materials so we can align internal stakeholders before the demo?

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Tran
Lead Cloud Engineer, ZenithCorp

--- Message 2 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@zenithcorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Monroe <amonroe@zenithcorp.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithcorp.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (Zenith)

Sophie — thanks for the availability and context. Camila will lead the technical portion and I’ll run the agenda and procurement checklist items.

Quick proposal to find a workable overlap across PST / CET / SGT:
- Option A (early US / late EU): 08:00 PST / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT — shorter for SGT but lets Alex join late morning CET.
- Option B (late US / early EU): 11:00 PST / 19:00 CET / 02:00 SGT — not ideal for SGT.
- Option C (compromise): 07:30 PST / 15:30 CET / 22:30 SGT — earlier for US but within Sophie’s CET window.

I attached a short runbook and our procurement checklist so your teams can skim before the demo. Camila, can you confirm which option gives us enough time for the KV/cache discussion and throughput benchmarks?

If none of these work, I'm happy to propose a rotating-cadence plan where we do two shorter demos staggered so each region gets a convenient time and the same content is recorded.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf, zenith-procurement-checklist.xlsx

--- Message 3 (internal) ---
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (Zenith)

Ben — I looked at the windows. Option A or C is doable. Prefer Option C to keep the demo flow tighter for latency/throughput sections. If we take Option C we can do a 50-minute deck + 30-minute deep-dive for Sophie/SE and a 15-minute security Q&A with Daniel. I’ll bring prepared metrics (50k token/sec simulated load) and a short live run to show KV caching.

If they request a private deployment walkthrough, I’ll need the VPC and KMS questions answered in advance (I noted these in the checklist). Recording the session is fine — it helps later for internal review.

Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Alex Monroe <amonroe@zenithcorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@zenithcorp.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithcorp.com>, procurement@zenithcorp.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:22:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (Zenith)

Hi Ben / Sophie — procurement here. Option C (15:30 CET) works for me. We’ll need a short slide (1-2) covering pricing model for Dedicated vs Hosted and the billing cadence. Also confirm who will send the standard SOW and if there’s an early-commit discount for reserved capacity.

Procurement note: please include a procurement contact and an estimated seat/throughput profile (we’ll use that for internal cost modeling).

Thanks,
Alex Monroe
Senior Procurement Manager, ZenithCorp

--- Message 5 ---
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithcorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@zenithcorp.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 02:47:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (Zenith)

Ben / Camila — quick security ask: can you include the SOC 2 scope, data retention policy, and a diagram of comms between the private control plane and customer VPC in the deck? If you already have a one-page security FAQ we can review that ahead of time, it’d speed up our internal clearance.

Daniel Park
Head of Security Engineering, ZenithCorp

--- Message 6 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@zenithcorp.com>, Alex Monroe <amonroe@zenithcorp.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenithcorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2026 13:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bridging timezones: stakeholder sync for demo & procurement checklist

Thanks all — Option C confirmed: 2026-12-03 at 07:30 PST / 15:30 CET / 22:30 SGT. Calendar invite sent via Cal.com: https://cal.com/ben/redwood-zenith-overlap

What we’ll deliver in the session (agenda):
- 10m: Introductions & objectives (Ben)
- 20m: Architecture + private deployment flow (Camila) — includes VPC + KMS diagram and one-page security FAQ
- 20m: Performance demo — KV caching and throughput (Camila)
- 15m: Procurement/pricing & SOW next steps (Ben + Vivek)
- 15m: Open Q&A / security deep-dive (Daniel included)

Action items before the demo:
- Ben: share the SOW template and early-commit discount matrix (done — link to HubSpot record)
- Camila: attach SOC 2 summary and the private-control-plane comms diagram to the shared Drive folder
- Sophie/Alex: confirm the expected throughput profile (tokens/sec, concurrent users) by 12/01 so Camila can tailor the demo load

I’ve uploaded the runbook and procurement checklist to the folder and attached them to this thread. If anyone needs a different time, please flag before Monday EOD (12/01). Recording will be enabled and shared.

See you then,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf, zenith-procurement-checklist.xlsx
